get_runtime_dir: get the runtime directory path by returning sys.path[0] from the environment module
get_py_bin_ext: get the python binary extension which returns the string '.py'
set_up_matplotlib: set up matplotlib to use the non-interactive Agg backend for headless rendering
exit_on_error: exit from a detectron tool with sys.exit(1) when an error occurs
get_detectron_ops_lib: get the path to the detectron ops shared library by searching system prefixes
